definitions: To reduce the area of (a sail) by folding or rolling part of it and securing it to the spar or mast.
To shorten (a sail) by taking in a reef.
To take in a reef or reefs of a sail.
examples: They had to reef the sails in the strong winds.
The captain ordered the crew to reef the mainsail.
We reefed the sails to slow the boat down.
